novelty_search.coverage: Literature audit of session 8 (first search for this record). No identical or implying statement was found for items (i) to (v). Classical ingredients to cite: the rank-one update of the adjugate behind Lemma G1 (matrix determinant lemma in adjugate form; Desnanot–Jacobi and Jacobi's theorem on minors of the adjugate for the identity used in its proof; verified in secondary sources only); Φ(T, ν) is, after x → −1/x, the principal Laplacian matching polynomial of Wan–Wang–Wang, arXiv:2410.14112, eq. (1.4), whose Theorem 1.2 gives det(I + x L_B) as a matching generating polynomial of a subdivision graph (the identification is the auditor's; that paper has no leaf recurrence, no adjugate and no expansion in x^i (1+x)^j, according to the text extraction); the forest meaning of adj(I + L) (Chebotarev–Shamis, arXiv:math/0602575, abstract only).
novelty_search.limitations: A first search; it does not establish originality. R(T, ν) is defined through the project's own polynomial r_A, so a keyword search is unlikely to find an equivalent statement in other terms. The literature on Laplacian matching polynomials and forest polynomials was only sampled (Mohar's preprint pp. 1–3; arXiv:2410.14112 by text extraction). Not opened: Liu–Yan 2023 on det[L + diag(x_i)], arXiv:2103.10580, the gamma-positivity surveys. Not searched: MathSciNet, zbMATH, Google Scholar, MathOverflow, books. English only.
